historical_context.time_period: Undated Sa'auei'a daily life before or during early imperial contact; no exact era claim is required by the scene.
historical_context.location: The story-local Four-Return feeding apron on the south edge of an unnamed sub-Umbros Sa'auei'a breeding ground, between nursery hollows, a candle road, prismwake wetland, and a glassback warming lane.
historical_context.summary: During ordinary post-eclipse contribution work, a planned reproductive draw collides with increased infant heat need and a prestigious family's incomplete mineral return. A rotating caretaker must allocate material capacity without converting scheduling authority into ownership.

public_facts.text: A breeding ground is a reproductive commons, care center, legal anchor, and memory reservoir rather than a city or lineage property.
A usable pulse niche requires timed light, stored sugar, mineral recycling, mobile heat or other local substitutes, route access, and skilled care to overlap.
Mobile families maintain breeding-ground capacity through material carriage, route repair, organism care, specialist escort, and obligations to living infrastructure.
Route-rich standing can improve access to scarce reproductive windows even when formal ownership is forbidden, creating class pressure inside reciprocity.

ambient_pressures.text: Dependent care must be protected before elective reproductive and adult draws, but actual missing capacity still has consequences.
Caretakers can schedule and witness draws while roads, trees, mats, herds, and other partners retain material vetoes.
An overdraw reduces later capacity through multiple linked partners, so immediate success can still become seasonal debt.

groups.label: Feeding-apron caretaker rotation
institutional_logic: Protect dependent care, expose material limits, preserve future pulses, and schedule claims without becoming owners of the commons.
material_incentives: Maintain heat, nutrient paste, clean graft capacity, specialist time, partner trust, and an archive other rotations can use.
prestige_markers: A pulse that arrives with margin
A delayed draw preserved rather than erased
emotional_display_norms: Competence is shown through low work, exact handling, open facial-fan signals, dry correction, and willingness to name shortages before they become injuries.
trust_defaults: Trusts converging material evidence and remembered conduct; refuses to confuse either with unlimited current capacity.
speech_register_cues: Public distinction between claim and capacity

groups.label: Route-rich Sa'auei'a family networks
institutional_logic: Convert broad remembered service into reliable travel, specialist exchange, witnessed claims, and reproductive continuity.
material_incentives: Reach safe pulse windows, keep route credit portable, defend family archive privacy, and make costly rescue work count.
internal_shames: Using prestige to hide an incomplete contribution
prestige_markers: Specialists who travel under the family mark
Reproductive claims met in the safest windows
taboo_triggers: Treating earned standing as hereditary ownership
Demanding private archive depth for one transaction
Erasing rescue labor from an account
emotional_display_norms: Formal confidence and open facial fans display standing; public shortage closes the fans before it raises the voice.
trust_defaults: Expects long service to receive flexible accommodation, but knows a road can still distinguish yesterday's generosity from today's missing salt.
speech_register_cues: Repair promises measured in journeys and tasks

groups.label: Feeding-apron ecological partners
institutional_logic: Keep light, heat, minerals, decomposition, grazing, shelter, and route traffic mutually viable across repeated eclipse pulses.
material_incentives: Receive clean tissue, mineral movement, careful grazing, parasite removal, spore carriage, route traffic, and truthful disclosure.
internal_shames: Being forced into a human-shaped supplier category
emotional_display_norms: Position is made visible through plate color, route brightness, lantern patterns, mat closure, and movement away.
trust_defaults: Each partner remembers on its own channel and timescale; overlap supports action but does not create one private collective voice.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Caretakers make consequential allocation declarations while lacking ownership of the contributors, recipients, and material channels.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Offer Tesh choices that move matter, expose records, request testimony, delay claims, or open consent; never make declaration sufficient by itself.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Broad ecological standing is productive social capacity and an advantage that can reproduce itself through safer timing and easier substitution.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep Varo's family genuinely useful and genuinely advantaged; do not flatten the conflict into fraud versus fairness.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Spending one contributor's margin changes what every adjacent contributor can safely offer in later pulses.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make reserve use and overdraw visible as dimming, cooling, closing pores, rerouting herds, and smaller future capacity.

observer_read: Prestige that may pressure the schedule
target_self_read: A family whose past and present work keeps the commons supplied
A claimant entitled to have rescue labor counted
misread_patterns: Reducing broad service to privilege alone
Treating current shortage as proof that old contributions were false
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Tesh distinguish earned standing from available capacity while recognizing that scheduling neutrality can preserve class advantage.

observer_read: Temporary stewards using a shortage to discount mobile labor
Residents at risk of becoming a gatekeeping class
target_self_read: Caretakers protecting dependents and future capacity under plural witness
misread_patterns: Treating requested evidence as a demand for full archive custody
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Varo resist humiliation and resident capture without pretending the missing mineral input is only politics.

observer_read: Witnesses, suppliers, vetoes, and current capacity signals
target_self_read: Unavailable as one unified self-description; each organism and route retains its own appetite, memory, and boundary.
misread_patterns: Treating convergent signals as one vote
Treating stored credit as purchased obedience
Treating a bright lane as unlimited supply
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the ecological web exact in behavior and opaque in private motive.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A temporary steward who can handle stores and declare allocations but cannot own the pulse or force its contributors.
A mobile family representative whose valid service history, reproductive timing, archive privacy, and public standing are all exposed by one missing input.
obligations: Offer repair the route can recognize
failure_modes: Turning broad contribution into inherited priority

role_pressure_fields.summary: A long-resident witness who protects continuity and watches temporary scheduling authority for signs of becoming a resident class.
failure_modes: Mistaking residence for superior moral standing

known_context.text: Tesh knows current stores, public draws, caretaker procedure, feeding-apron geometry, and signals visible from the work rail.

beliefs.text: Tesh believes dependent care has priority and every exception must expose who pays the next pulse.

misreads.text: Tesh may underweight how public disclosure can turn a repairable shortfall into lineage humiliation.

must_not_know.text: Tesh must not know partner motives, the exact amount spent at the alleged rescue, or the waiting family's private reproductive state beyond offered testimony.

known_context.text: Varo knows the family contribution history, the scheduled draw, the missing packet, the rescue account, and the archive layer the family may choose to expose.

beliefs.text: Varo believes a family that spent matter protecting a shared calving lane should not lose its safest reproductive interval for arriving with less fungible tribute.

misreads.text: Varo may read the caretaker's capacity limit as resident contempt for mobile work.

must_not_know.text: Varo must not know whether road, mat, grove, or herd will accept a future repair promise before their visible behavior changes.

known_context.text: Oru knows the commons archive, dependent-care demand, caretaker rotation history, and visible ledger mutations.

beliefs.text: Oru believes a commons fails when temporary allocation power becomes permanent class office or when shared obligation is declared without consent.

misreads.text: Oru may treat procedural novelty as ownership drift sooner than the evidence warrants.

must_not_know.text: Oru must not know Varo's unoffered archive layers or the private condition of the family members waiting beyond the road.

author_only_boundaries.text: Tesh, Varo, Oru, the ash-striped herd, Four-Return, and this exact allocation are story-local inventions and do not establish Weksa vocabulary, named geography, or canon history.
The fixture does not decide whether Varo's family diverted exactly the claimed material amount; archive and herd evidence verify rescue work while leaving quantity disputed.
Reproductive physiology, conception procedure, gestation anatomy, and exact resource recipes remain unspecified; the scene models allocation surfaces only.

The pulse basin, heat braid, Four-Return apron geometry, and exact arrangement of partner species are story-local implementations of the canonized material flows, not universal breeding-ground infrastructure.

open_questions.question: What exact reproductive tissues, phases, and medical work make one Sa'auei'a draw distinct from infant or adult recovery care?
open_questions.notes: The fixture deliberately uses a scheduled reproductive draw, clean graft bath, nutrient paste, heat, and specialist time without inventing anatomy.

open_questions.question: Is pulse niche a useful standardized trade-translation term or only a story-local explanatory handle?
open_questions.notes: The owning lore note marks the term as trade translation; Weksa should eventually supply culture- and partner-specific language.

open_questions.question: Which breeding-ground localities can combine prismwake wetland, lantern grove, candle road, and glassback heat within one compact apron?
open_questions.notes: The scene uses one plausible story-local overlap and does not claim it is the universal breeding-ground layout.
